nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Breakout Salicylic Acid Acne Serum

avis.texte: I've been using this for maybe 2.5 months... maybe a month ago, it dawned on me that my often broken out face was clear (knock on wood)... for an extended period of time?? unheard of for me. I have random flare ups with breakouts, it's not crazy in the grand scheme of things, but annoying for a 25 yr old to have acne. the only thing that has changed in my routine is this serum.. so if this is what has helped my skin the past month or so, then it's worth a shot. it's not cheap, I initially bought it on sale but just repurchased at full price, and it takes at least a month of regular use to see a change, but I think it's worth it. it may not be the cure all, but if you have more so hormonal sporadic acne with little popups every bit or so... this may be for you.

I have cystic acne, very bad. Medication and sometimes even surgery to fix. This product is used, no breakouts at all. And cured so many of the cysts. They've gone dome over 90% in a weeks use every day.

I really did want to like this serum, but it did not do much, which is surprising considering the ingredients. Not only does it have 2% salicylic acid, but it also contains lactic acid. It is lightweight and easy enough to use, but you could buy a Paula's Choice exfoliant for the same price and get better results. I might recommend this, however, to someone who has sensitive skin, wants to exfoliate, and needs something gentle.
